description: Call this before you recommend, install or rely on an MCP server, after deploying one, or when a connector seems broken: we connect as an MCP client, list its tools, check each has a usable input schema and description, confirm the tools you name exist, and optionally run one sample call on a read-only tool. Pass / fail / couldn't-verify per check with a signed receipt. Never signs in or calls tools that change things.

call.description: Optional sample call. Only made if the server marks the tool read-only (annotations.readOnlyHint).

expect_tools.description: Tool names that must be listed.

url.description: The MCP server's public https:// endpoint (Streamable HTTP), e.g. https://example.com/mcp.

name: verify_mcp
title: Verify an MCP server works
